title: LeadFlow V2 — API-Based Lead Qualification & Workflow Automation
description: Built an API-backed lead qualification and CRM workflow demonstration using Cloudflare Pages Functions. Four synthetic scenarios run through server validation, explainable scoring, routing policy and a timed event trace. I implemented the responsive frontend, endpoint, sandbox CRM contract, browser-local records, draft-only follow-ups and timeout/retry simulations, with automated tests. No external CRM or LLM is represented as connected. Live review: https://evidence-review.leadflow-evidence-v2.pages.dev/

gallery.caption: LeadFlow V2 engineering case study — real Cloudflare edge API with documented sandbox boundaries
Qualified test lead: server-backed 96/100 score, timed event stream and local record proof
Two injected CRM sandbox timeouts and third-attempt recovery with observable trace
Explicit system responsibility and trust boundary diagram
Mobile execution view verified at 390px with no horizontal overflow
